prespecified: Fixed 2026-11-16, before any result was read. Pilot, not a measurement: it passes when every cell has a valid outcome (death, turn_cap or borg_stopped), no cell is config_error, plan cells record 922372ba...cb160cd and ambitious cells 9d7d8a39...d59dd2, and no cell needs a rerun. The plan in force is evidenced by the core's copy of the loaded plan in the cell's output directory (errands_plan.txt), whose sha256 must equal the requested plan's, and which must be absent in no-plan arms; otherwise the cell is config_error. A cell with 1,000 or more keys at a single game turn (borg-rs#90's oil store/take loop at the Home: 4,315-5,141 keys per burst against at most 383 in normal play) is recorded as stalled, with its observed outcome kept, and is reported separately like the other incomplete outcomes; final key counts are also reported per arm. Nothing is compared for an effect.
